_comment: Committed baseline for the Tier 1 walk-forward regression case (scripts/eval/run.py). This is a regression check, not a performance claim: it says `just walkforward demo` still reproduces the same numbers on the same seeded synthetic data, not that the demo model has edge. FAIL is the expected, correct verdict here because GATE_DSR=1.0 in ml/validation/walkforward.py is designed to be unreachable (see CLAUDE.md rule 6/7) until a human sets a real deflated-Sharpe threshold. Recorded from `just walkforward demo` (scratch mode) on 2026-09-28, matching the committed demo record in research/registry/log/models.jsonl.
